headings.title: Required contents of arbitration notification and statement of rights
headings.reviewNote: Covers required notice contents including statement of issue and statutory rights to counsel, subpoenas, evidence, cross-examination, and adjournment.

headings.title: Arbitrator background and qualifications statement
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that notification detail the name, experience, and educational background of each neutral arbitrator.

headings.title: Hearing continuance for failure to provide notification
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that failure to provide required notification constitutes grounds for a continuance of at least ten days.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: required arbitration notice of issue and statutory rights, neutral arbitrator background statement, and 10-day hearing continuance grounds for noncompliance.

headings.title: Subpoena immunity for arbitrators, conciliators, and mediators
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibition against subpoenaing or compelling arbitrators, conciliators, mediators, or staff to disclose matters from dispute proceedings.

headings.title: Confidentiality and inadmissibility of dispute resolution communications
headings.reviewNote: Covers classification of proceedings as settlement negotiations, making communications confidential and inadmissible in evidence or discovery.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: subpoena immunity for arbitrators, conciliators, mediators, and staff upon written submission agreement, and settlement-negotiation confidentiality and inadmissibility.

headings.title: Court order compelling arbitration upon application
headings.reviewNote: Covers judicial orders compelling arbitration upon showing of agreement and refusal, and summary determination if agreement existence is denied.

headings.title: Stay of arbitration proceedings on application
headings.reviewNote: Covers judicial stay of arbitration upon showing that no arbitration agreement exists, following summary trial of disputed issues.

headings.title: Venue for arbitration applications during pending actions
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that applications be made in the court where an action involving the arbitrable issue is pending, or in competent court.

headings.title: Mandatory stay of court proceedings involving arbitrable issues
headings.reviewNote: Covers mandatory stay of court actions or proceedings involving arbitrable issues upon application or order for arbitration.

headings.title: Merits or fault immaterial to arbitration order
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule prohibiting refusal of arbitration orders on grounds that the claim lacks merit or fault has not been shown.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections against archived text: mandatory orders compelling arbitration, permissive stays of arbitration, venue during pending actions, mandatory stay of court actions on arbitrable issues, and immateriality of claim merits.

headings.title: Arbitrator subpoena power and court enforcement
headings.reviewNote: Covers arbitrator authority to issue subpoenas for witnesses and documents, administer oaths, and obtain judicial enforcement in civil action manner.

headings.title: Depositions of unavailable witnesses on arbitrator authorization
headings.reviewNote: Covers arbitrator permission for taking depositions of unavailable or non-subpoenaable witnesses for evidentiary use.

headings.title: Statutory witness compulsion laws applicable
headings.reviewNote: Covers application of all general legal provisions compelling subpoenaed persons to testify in arbitration proceedings.

headings.title: Witness attendance fees equivalent to circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Covers entitlement of arbitration witnesses to attendance fees equal to circuit court witness fees.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections against archived text: permissive arbitrator subpoena power and court enforcement, unavailable-witness depositions, applicability of witness compulsion laws, and circuit-court witness fees.

headings.title: Written signed award and delivery to parties
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that arbitration awards be in writing, signed by joining arbitrators, and delivered personally, by registered mail, or per agreement.

headings.title: Timeframe for award, extensions, and waiver of late objection
headings.reviewNote: Covers deadlines for making awards, written extensions, and waiver of timeliness objections absent notice prior to delivery.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: written signed award and delivery methods, and award timing, written extensions, and pre-delivery objection waiver.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for vacating arbitration awards
headings.reviewNote: Covers five statutory grounds to vacate awards including fraud, corruption, evident partiality, exceeding powers, hearing misconduct, or absent agreement.

headings.title: Ninety-day limitation period for application to vacate
headings.reviewNote: Covers ninety-day deadline from delivery to apply for vacatur, extended from discovery date for corruption or fraud claims.

headings.title: Rehearing before new or original arbitrators following vacatur
headings.reviewNote: Covers judicial discretion to order rehearings before new or original arbitrators depending on vacatur grounds.

headings.title: Mandatory confirmation upon denial of application to vacate
headings.reviewNote: Covers mandatory judicial confirmation of the award if the application to vacate is denied and no motion to modify is pending.

headings.title: De novo judicial review of child-related arbitration awards
headings.reviewNote: Subjects arbitration awards in chapter 452 or 454 proceedings that determine an issue regarding a child of the marriage to de novo judicial review.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections against archived text (including 1998 Edward D. Jones & Co. case annotation); broadened subsection 5 title to cover any child-of-the-marriage determination under chapters 452 or 454.

headings.title: Statutory grounds for modifying or correcting awards within ninety days
headings.reviewNote: Covers application within ninety days to modify awards for miscalculation, unsubmitted matters, or formal imperfections not affecting merits.

headings.title: Modification and confirmation or confirmation as made
headings.reviewNote: Covers court duty to modify and confirm award to effect intent, or otherwise confirm award as originally made.

headings.title: Alternative joinder with application to vacate
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization to join an application to modify or correct in the alternative with an application to vacate.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text: 90-day grounds to modify or correct awards, mandatory modification/confirmation, and permissive alternative joinder with vacatur applications.

headings.title: Entry and enforcement of judgment on confirmed or modified award
headings.reviewNote: Covers entry and enforcement of judgments or decrees conforming to confirmed, modified, or corrected arbitration awards and award of costs.

headings.title: Personal injury arbitration awards not binding on non-agreeing insurers
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that personal injury or death arbitration awards and judgments are inadmissible and not binding on or collectible from non-consenting insurers.

headings.title: Insurer defined
headings.reviewNote: Covers definition of insurer including authorized liability insurance entities, risk management entities, and public liability funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text (L. 2021 H.B. 345): judgment entry and discretionary costs, non-binding/inadmissible status of personal injury or death awards against non-agreeing insurers, and insurer definition.

headings.title: Preparation and contents of judgment roll
headings.reviewNote: Covers clerk preparation of judgment roll containing the arbitration agreement, extensions, award, orders, and final judgment or decree.

headings.title: Docketing of judgment or decree as rendered in civil action
headings.reviewNote: Covers authorization to docket arbitration judgments or decrees as if rendered in ordinary civil actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: clerk preparation and contents of the judgment roll and permissive docketing as in a civil action.

headings.title: Orders and judgments subject to appeal
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory list of six appealable orders and judgments including orders denying compulsion, granting stays, confirming, modifying, or vacating awards.

headings.title: Standard civil appellate procedure applicable
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that appeals are taken in the same manner and extent as orders or judgments in ordinary civil actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text (including 2016 Sanford v. Centurytel case annotation on immediate appealability of orders denying arbitration): six appealable orders/judgments and civil appellate procedure.

headings.title: Applicability to commercial persons and enforceability
headings.reviewNote: Limits sections 435.350 to 435.470 to written arbitration agreements between commercial persons or between commercial persons and noncommercial counterparties, declaring them valid, enforceable, and irrevocable except on contract-revocation grounds.

headings.title: Commercial persons defined to exclude governmental entities
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory definition of commercial persons as all persons and legal entities excluding governments and governmental subdivisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text; revised subsection 1 title to accurately reflect applicability to commercial persons and their noncommercial counterparties rather than strictly commercial-only agreements.
